blocks.title: Molar volume
blocks.text: The volume of one mole of an ideal gas at STP (Standard temperature and pressure) is called molar volume.

Its value is equal to 22.414 dm³. The value of molar volume is commonly rounded to 22.4 dm³. It is denoted by Vₘ. By using molar volume relationship, mass or mole of a gas at STP can be converted into volume, and vice versa.

blocks.title: Avogadro’s law
blocks.text: According to Avogadro’s law, “Equal volumes of all ideal gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules”.

This statement is indirectly the same when we say that one mole of an ideal gas at 273.16 K and one atm pressure has a volume of 22.414 dm³. Since one mole of a gas has Avogadro’s number of particles, so 22.414 dm³ of various ideal gases at STP will have Avogadro’s number of molecules i.e., 6.02 × 10²³.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Standard temperature (STP) is 0 °C = 273.15 K, not 273.16 K (273.16 K is the triple point of water).
22.4 dm³ of a gas at STP = Molar mass of a gas = 6.02 x 10²³ particles of a gas = 1 mole of a gas

items: 22.4 dm³ of CO₂ at STP = 44.0 g of CO₂ = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules of CO₂ = 1mole of CO₂
22.4 dm³ of any gas at STP = molar mass in grams = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1mole
22.4 dm³ of H₂ gas at STP = 2 g = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1mole
22.4 dm³ of NH₃ gas at STP = 17 g = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1mole

blocks.text: If the number of moles of a gas is known, one can calculate the volume of a gas by multiplying number of moles of the gas by molar volume.

blocks.latex: \text{Volume of a gas} = \text{Number of moles} \times \text{Molar volume}
blocks.text_alt: Volume of a gas = Number of moles x Molar volume

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.7
blocks.problem: Determine the volume of 2.5 moles of chlorine molecules at STP.
steps: The formula for volume determination at STP
blocks.answer: 2.5 mole of Cl₂ occupy a volume = 22.4 dm³ x 2.5 = 56.0 dm³

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.8
blocks.problem: What is the volume in dm³ of 4.75 mol of methane (CH₄) gas at STP?
steps: The formula for volume determination at STP
blocks.answer: Volume of methane in dm³ at STP = 4.75 x 22.4 = 106.4 dm³
